# Country scope. Any human player, great power, or substantial realm (non-rebel).
oe_react_is_eligible_realm = {
	oe_main_mod_global_event_allowed = yes
	oe_years_since_start >= 10
	num_locations >= 1
	OR = {
		is_human = yes
		is_great_power = yes
		num_locations >= 8
	}
}

# Country scope. Eligible maritime realm with at least 3 ports.
oe_react_is_coastal_realm = {
	oe_react_is_eligible_realm = yes
	has_ports = yes
	num_of_ports >= 3
}

# Country scope. Debt pressure gate for sovereign debt reaction.
oe_react_has_debt_pressure = {
	oe_react_is_eligible_realm = yes
	num_loans >= 3
}

# Country scope. Battle defeat triggers domestic estate/parliament crisis instead of rally.
oe_react_has_battle_crisis = {
	OR = {
		war_exhaustion >= 6
		has_parliament = yes
	}
}

# Country scope. Eligibility for Anti-Piracy Patrol decision.
oe_react_can_anti_piracy_patrol = {
	oe_react_is_eligible_realm = yes
	has_ports = yes
	NOT = { has_variable = oe_react_dec_patrol_cd }
}

# Country scope. Eligibility for Charter Free Company decision.
oe_react_can_charter_free_company = {
	oe_react_is_eligible_realm = yes
	exists = capital
	NOT = { has_variable = oe_react_dec_company_cd }
}
